name: CTRPad
notes: CTRPad owns padmint.json in its repository. The build needs no game file; players choose their own NTSC-U BIN in the app. Releases publish the recipe only.

steps: Open {file} and move CTRPad.app to your Applications folder.
Open CTRPad and choose your own Crash Team Racing disc image (the BIN) when it asks; the full guide below shows how.
Updating? Replace the old CTRPad.app with the new one. Your saves and disc choice are kept.
Abre {file} y mueve CTRPad.app a tu carpeta Aplicaciones.

¿Actualizando? Reemplaza el CTRPad.app anterior por el nuevo. Tus partidas guardadas y el disco elegido se conservan.
